newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki CEO optimistic on steel price.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki CEO optimistic on steel price.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy's president and chief executive officer Mikko Kivimaki said on Saturday he was quite optimistic on the outlook in Europe for steel product prices.

"I am quite optimistic regarding the price outlook in Europe," Kivimaki told a weekend news conference ahead of the opening here on Monday of the annual conference of the International Iron and Steel Institute (IISI).
"In hot and cold rolled products, prices have reached bottom, but we cannot yet see increasing prices," he said, adding: "But I am very optimistic." @
In galvanised and coated steel products, "the price increase has already picked up," Kivimaki said.

Last Friday, in a profit warning statement, Rautaruukki said prices of steel products had fallen in May-August clearly more than expected, but looked likely to stabilise in the final four-month period of 1996.
Prices of some products had already turned into a rise, Rautaruukki said.
